sentences.en: Many groups of immigrants have been assimilated into American society.
sentences.zh: 许多移民群体已经融入了美国社会。

sentences.en: Poor Japanese immigrants were willing to work for low pay.
sentences.zh: 贫穷的日裔移民愿意低薪工作。

sentences.en: Workers in these factories comprise a large percentage of immigrants.
sentences.zh: 这些工厂里的工人中有很大一部分是移民。
